zh: 更新语音录音入口，修复打开语音输入时的闪退。翻译页可用右上角「完成」、点空白或上滑收起键盘。
顺序为聊天、行程、插件、记忆。邀请码与记忆编辑也可用「完成」收起键盘。
en: Updated the recording entry to address the crash when opening voice input. In Translation, tap Done at the top right, tap an empty spot, or swipe up to dismiss the keyboard.
The tabs are Chat, Trips, Tools, and Memory. Done also dismisses the keyboard on the invitation and memory editing screens.

zh: 与构建 49 相比，翻译使用千问和香港翻译服务，需要联网。语音和照片上传后显示「正在识别并翻译…」。
en: Compared with build 49, translation uses Qwen through the Hong Kong translation service and requires an internet connection. After sending audio or a photo, the app shows “Recognizing and translating…”.

zh: 打开「插件 → 翻译」，点语音入口，核对不闪退。打开录音后可切后台结束这次录音。
翻译页输入几字，分别用「完成」、点空白和上滑收起键盘，确认输入保留、按钮位置正常。核对四个底部入口的顺序。
抽测构建 49 的第 1、3、4 项：强退重开恢复旧对话和草稿，历史分别打开旧和新对话，切后台 10 秒及锁屏 60 秒后恢复。
en: Open Tools → Translation and tap voice input. Check that the app stays open. You can leave the app in the background to end the recording.
Enter a few words in Translation. Dismiss the keyboard with Done, an empty-area tap, and an upward swipe. Check that the draft and buttons stay in place. Check the four tabs in order.
Repeat build 49 checks 1, 3, and 4: force-quit and restore an older chat and its draft, open both chats from history, then return after 10 seconds in the background and 60 seconds locked.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 真实翻译等账号开通通知后再测。收到通知后，文字中英各三条、语音中英各三次（含无声录音），并用菜单、路牌、小票和药品说明各三张照片核对结果。
en: Wait until your account is enabled before checking live translation. When notified, translate three texts and three recordings in each direction, including a silent recording, and test three photos each of menus, signs, receipts, and medicine instructions.

zh: 本次先核对 App 操作。服务可用后会在 #1274 补发真实翻译复测通知。
en: This round focuses on app interactions. See #1274 for the live translation retest notice once the service is enabled.

zh: 从行程列表打开已保存的行程时，iOS 18 或更新版本从所点卡片缩放到详情。
内测新增「插件」页。翻译支持中英文字、语音和图片，可复制或朗读译文，在本机查看最近记录。
修复删除一条记忆后列表可能加载失败的问题，并提高「更多记忆」按钮的可读性。
en: On iOS 18 or later, opening a saved itinerary from Trips zooms from the selected card into its details.
The internal build adds the Tools tab. Translate Chinese and English text, speech, and photos, copy or listen to translations, and view recent translations on this device.
Fixed an issue where the memory list could fail to reload after deleting an entry and made the More memories button easier to read.

zh: 与构建 48 相比，行程列表新增缩放转场。从聊天打开行程详情时，沿用系统默认转场。
与构建 48 相比，本版新增中英翻译，删掉一条记忆后可以继续查看其余记忆。
en: Compared with build 48, opening details from the Trips list uses a zoom transition. Opening details from Chat still uses the standard navigation animation.
Compared with build 48, this build adds Chinese and English translation and keeps the remaining memories visible after you delete an entry.

zh: 从行程列表打开一条已保存行程。返回后，确认同一张卡片可见并能再次打开。
从聊天内已保存的行程卡点“查看”，确认打开同一条行程。再检查深色和减弱动态效果。
在 iOS 18 或更新版本打开「插件」→「翻译」，按需连接 Wi-Fi 下载语言包。输入或粘贴一句话，互换中英后再试，核对离线标识、复制、朗读和最近记录。
用中英各试一小段语音和一张有两行文字的图片。分别试拍照和相册，对照识别出的文字和译文。若拒绝权限，查看设置提示。
en: Open a saved itinerary from Trips. Go back and check that the same card is visible and opens again.
Tap View on a saved itinerary card in Chat and check that it opens the same itinerary. Repeat in Dark Mode and with Reduce Motion enabled.

On iOS 18 or later, open Tools → Translation and download the languages over Wi-Fi if prompted. Type or paste a sentence, swap Chinese and English, then check the offline label, copying, playback, and recent translations.
Try a short recording and a two-line image in each language. Try the camera and Photos and check the originals and translations. If you deny permission, check the Settings guidance.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: iOS 17 或开启减弱动态效果时使用系统默认转场。真机转场体验仍待确认。
行程正式保存、修改与撤销，以及全国规划仍在验证。
本版翻译使用 Apple 本机能力，离线译文需要 iOS 18 或更新版本和已下载的语言包。iOS 17 可以打开插件页、查看照片识别出的文字。麦克风和相机效果待 iPhone 真机验证。
en: iOS 17 and Reduce Motion use the standard navigation animation. The animation is awaiting verification on an iPhone.
Formal itinerary saving, edits and undo, and planning across China are still being validated.

This build uses Apple on-device translation, which requires iOS 18 or later and downloaded languages. On iOS 17, you can open Tools and read text recognized from photos. Microphone and camera behavior still need iPhone verification.

zh: 构建 49 的真机七项按 #702 的本版通知执行。构建 48 的清单供回看，服务窗口见 #1048。
en: For the seven build 49 iPhone checks, follow the build 49 announcement in #702. Keep the build 48 checklist for reference. See #1048 for the live testing window.
